name: NGFS public proxy initialization
summary: NGFSToken left its single-use proxy initializer public, letting the attacker appoint its own contract as both privileged proxy and library, credit itself an unbacked NGFS balance, and sell it against the NGFS/USDT pool.
notes: NGFSToken is direct non-proxy code. Its public first-caller-wins delegateCallReserves initializer and reserveMultiSync's unbacked balance addition were present at deployment and remained executable until the exploit. Liquidity and trading changes only altered exposure; the attacker claimed the latent initializer inside the exploit transaction, so that attacker-installed state is the exploit rather than an age reset.

The NGFS/USDT pair's USDT balance fell from 192,044.910952619638111430 to 1,906.152962308879782744 in the exploit transaction. Its only USDT transfer was the exact 190,138.757990310758328686 payout to the attacker contract, which began with zero USDT and retained the full amount. Stablecoin-par valuation therefore equals the exact gross LP depletion.
